Supreme Court takes note of Rajasthan ranger's killing amid illegal mining

The Supreme Court has taken note of the killing of forest ranger Pratap Singh Chundawat in Rajasthan, an incident linked to illegal mining. The court is seeking a response from the state government and has suggested that preventive detention should be used in such cases.
